news.title: Butler University Alumni Association Announces 2026 Alumni Awards Recipients
news.summary_en: The Butler University Alumni Association has announced the 2026 recipients of eight alumni awards, which honor individuals for their commitment to the University and to their communities. Award honorees will be recognized at a special Alumni Recognition Ceremony on September 18, 2026, during Butler’s annual Homecoming festivities.  This year’s recipients are: The Butler Medal: Jane…
news.author: jennifer gunnels
